premises.text: The consumer world is a mousetrap built to extract small impulse purchases at every turn
premises.evidence_span: literally like a mousetrap designed to get us to get an extra $5, $10 out of us at every possible moment

premises.text: Budgets, plans, and spreadsheets have not made people save
premises.evidence_span: you must use spreadsheets and budgets. Well, look at their results. It doesn't work.

premises.text: Onboarding creates a linked, FDIC-insured, interest-bearing piggy bank and personal savings goals
premises.evidence_span: they create an online piggy bank, a savings account that's FDIC-insured and interest-bearing

premises.text: The app converts the impulse to buy into a same-moment transfer to savings with immediate gratifying feedback
premises.evidence_span: have the amount she was just about to have spent be transferred automatically in that moment into her ImpulseSave savings account. Instantly, she sees a message coming back

premises.text: Optional sharing makes saving socially rewarding
premises.evidence_span: close to 40% of our users choose to share their impulse saves

premises.text: Users' own goals are marketed back to them via email updates, progress updates, and behavior- and location-based push notifications
premises.evidence_span: we're going to use our ninja marketing skills to market those to you

value.text: Ordinary Americans actually save money at the moment they would have impulsively spent it
value.evidence_span: These are actual Americans that are saving instead of buying.

causal_links.evidence_span: so that they can move money out of harm's way whenever they want to
These are exactly the kinds of impulse buys that are killing and bleeding the American public.

notes: Coarser reading: account setup and goals are one onboarding premise, and the sharing loop plus goal re-marketing sit with the transfer mechanism in a single product domain because the speaker presents them as one behavior-change engine that must be learned together. Channel list (Instagram/SMS/in-site) and planned matching funds folded per v1.3.2 clarification 5; savings metrics excluded as traction.
